en.headline: Saltwater pipe bursts in Tin Shui Wai, spraying two storeys high
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said flushing water to Tin Yuet Estate and part of Tin Chung Court was suspended and expected to resume at 7.30am on Sunday.
body: A saltwater pipe burst on Saturday evening in Tin Shui Wai, sending a jet of water about two storeys high from beneath a pedestrian footbridge entrance near the Hong Kong Young Women's Christian Association Lee Shau Kee Primary School on Tin Wing Road.

Police received multiple reports around 6.44pm. The Water Supplies Department said it was notified at about 7pm and confirmed the pipe was a 150-millimetre saltwater supply line used for flushing. After the valve was closed, the flow stopped.

The department said flushing water supply to Tin Yuet Estate and part of Tin Chung Court was affected. Repair work was under way, with supply expected to resume at 7.30am on Sunday. Road traffic was not affected, though some paving stones were displaced.
Residents of the two estates were advised to note the temporary suspension of saltwater for toilet flushing while the emergency works continued overnight.

zh.headline: 天水圍爆鹹水管水柱噴兩層樓高 天悅邨及天頌苑停沖廁水
zh.dek: 水務署指涉事為直徑150毫米鹹水供水管，天悅邨及部分天頌苑沖廁水暫停，預計周日早上7時半恢復。
body: 周六傍晚，天水圍天榮路近香港青年協會李兆基小學對開行人天橋入口地底一條鹹水管爆裂，噴出水柱高約兩層樓。
警方約傍晚6時44分接獲多宗報案。水務署表示約晚上7時接報，經了解確認涉事為一條直徑150毫米、供沖廁用的鹹水供水管。關上水撣後現場已停止湧水。
署方指天悅邨及部分天頌苑的鹹水供應受影響，正安排維修工程，預計周日早上7時半可恢復供應。事件未有影響道路交通，現場部分路磚被沖起。
兩屋苑居民需暫時改用其他方式處理沖廁用水，直至維修完成恢復供應。
